cooling_age.description: Represents the time elapsed since a compact stellar remnant ceased active nuclear fusion and began its thermal cooling phase, measured in gigayears (Gyr).

mass.description: Indicates the total gravitational mass of the stellar object, expressed in solar masses (Msun).

surface_gravity.description: Quantifies the base-10 logarithm of the surface gravitational acceleration, reported in decimal orders of magnitude (dex).
